layered_book.rationale: Reuse the finite holding/resource-asset P/B screening band; not peer-calibrated, an asset appraisal, or completed SOTP.

AB.route_reason: Resource and investment interests require attributable SOTP and common-claim reconciliation.
AB.intrinsic_blocker: 1H2026 parent equity is negative while total equity and printed BVPS are positive; minority attribution and common residual claims remain unresolved.
AB.source_warning: PSE 1H2026 parent equity is negative PHP390.230m despite PHP979.293m positive total equity. Printed PHP0.38 BVPS follows total equity, not a positive parent-common bridge; no book screen is published.

FPI.route_reason: Investment and resource interests require attributable SOTP; parent book is a separate screen.
FPI.intrinsic_blocker: Investment fair value, reserve rights, future funding and minority claims are not underwritten.
FPI.source_warning: PSE printed PHP0.22 BVPS exceeds PHP261.653m parent equity divided by 1.839bn outstanding shares. The screen uses the explicit parent/share bridge; FY2025 and 1H2026 gross revenue are zero.

FAF.route_reason: Subsidiary financial and investment interests require an attributable common-equity SOTP.
FAF.intrinsic_blocker: Negative parent equity, large consolidated liabilities and unresolved minority/capital claims prevent a positive common-equity book screen.
FAF.source_warning: 1H2026 parent equity is negative PHP684.616m; PHP20.009m positive total equity and printed PHP0.02 BVPS are not a parent-common residual. A total-book proxy would misstate the claim.

BH.route_reason: Investment holdings require attributable SOTP; current parent book per common share is only a finite screen.
BH.intrinsic_blocker: Investment realizability, minority interests and exceptionally thin trading are not underwritten.
BH.source_warning: Only 20,000 of 499,987 outstanding common shares appear listed, and the last trade is stale. Printed PHP199 BVPS follows PHP99.283m total equity; the screen uses PHP87.101m parent equity and the full outstanding common count, with no current-upside claim.

GEO.route_reason: Mineral interests need recoverable-reserve and common-equity underwriting, not a near-zero book extrapolation.
GEO.intrinsic_blocker: Near-exhausted parent equity, zero operating revenue and absent reserve economics make a finite PHP per-share screen economically misleading.
GEO.source_warning: Parent equity fell to PHP325,798 against 3.5bn shares; PSE prints BVPS as zero. A mechanically positive value below display precision is not published as an investment estimate.

UPM.route_reason: Mining claims require finite-life asset valuation and a post-recapitalization common-equity bridge.
UPM.intrinsic_blocker: Parent equity is negative and a disclosed debt-to-equity conversion could issue 40bn additional common shares; final capitalization and asset economics are unresolved.
UPM.source_warning: 1H2026 parent equity is negative PHP336.438m and reported EPS/BVPS round to zero. The proposed 40bn-share debt conversion is not silently treated as completed or ignored in a finite value.

MA.route_reason: Mining rights require finite-life reserve SOTP; pooled common book is a separate screen.
MA.intrinsic_blocker: Recoverable reserves, license life, reclamation, cash funding and class transition are not underwritten.
MA.source_warning: PSE reported PHP0.01 BVPS approximately reconciles to PHP3.361bn parent equity divided by both outstanding A and B common classes (311.504bn), not the MA line alone. Gross revenue is blank and interim parent income negative.

X.route_reason: A going-concern FCFF case needs supported recapitalization and normalized operating economics.
X.intrinsic_blocker: Negative parent/common equity and a disclosed recovery plan leave recapitalization, claims and sustainable cash flow unresolved.
X.source_warning: 1H2026 parent equity is negative PHP213.214m, total equity negative PHP364.473m and operating losses persist. No positive book multiple or current-upside claim is published.

MFC.route_reason: A cross-listed insurer requires common-capital residual income and approved CAD/PHP translation.
MFC.intrinsic_blocker: No reviewer-approved dated CAD/PHP observation, preferred/common claim bridge, or sustainable insurer ROE/capital case is available.
MFC.source_warning: PSE summary reports equity in C$ millions and parent attribution is blank. Reported C$27.48 BVPS cannot be presented as PHP per share; cross-listed price alone is not an intrinsic input.

SLF.route_reason: A cross-listed insurer requires common-capital residual income and approved CAD/PHP translation.
SLF.intrinsic_blocker: No reviewer-approved dated CAD/PHP observation, insurer common-claim bridge, or sustainable ROE/capital case is available.
SLF.source_warning: PSE summary reports equity in C$ millions and parent attribution is blank. Reported C$42.49 BVPS cannot be presented as PHP per share; cross-listed market price is not a substitute.
